feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Amateur cricketer 'Clicky Pointing' banned for two years over viral cheating
articles.summary: An amateur cricketer dubbed 'Clicky Pointing' has been banned from the sport for two years over cheating during games.

articles.title: Killer who bragged after fatally stabbing student jailed
articles.summary: A man who bragged after fatally stabbing an accounting student in southwest London has been jailed.

articles.title: Thomas Markle charged by FBI in Florida
articles.summary: The Duchess of Sussex's father, Thomas Markle Snr, has been charged by the FBI in Florida over child sexual abuse material.

articles.title: Russell Brand's barrister reports himself to watchdog over behaviour after verdict
articles.summary: Russell Brand's barrister has reported himself to his professional regulator after clashing with a journalist following the comedian's convictions.

articles.title: Met chief warns that 'policing will fail' without major reforms
articles.summary: Metropolitan Police Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley has warned that “policing will fail” without major reforms, including reducing the number of regional forces.

articles.title: Double murderer given extra 22 years for historical sexual assaults
articles.summary: A former Royal Navy petty officer who is serving a life sentence for two murders has been jailed for a further 22 years for sexually assaulting three young naval recruits and a 14-year-old boy in the 1990s.

articles.title: Two men charged with murder after death of non-league footballer
articles.summary: Two men have been charged with murder after the death of a non-league footballer.

articles.title: Poundland owner seeks private MP session 'to avoid show trial'
articles.summary: Poundland's owner is seeking to give evidence to MPs in private next week as it seeks to avoid an evidence session on the discount retailer's fate turning into "a show trial".

articles.title: Prison operator and health board admit criminal charges after death of inmate with COVID
articles.summary: A prison operator and an NHS health board have admitted criminal charges after the death of an imprisoned man who contracted COVID-19.

articles.title: Andrew made more than £2,000 a month subletting Royal Lodge cottages
articles.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor received more than £2,000 a month from renting out three cottages at his former Royal Lodge home, a report by the public spending watchdog has revealed.
